inclusion_rule: Surface-EMG speech or silent-speech decoding studies whose electrodes are dry, textile or printed and mounted on a worn object or garment (headphones, earphones, around-ear frame, glasses, mask, collar or choker, headband, patch-free garment) rather than adhesive gel electrodes placed one by one. Boundary: tattoo-like or adhesive dry patches count as dry electrodes but not as integrated into a worn object; wet adhesive arrays, non-speech EMG and non-EMG wearables (strain, acoustic) are excluded when read; versions count once.
